---
title: "3 — Enrich connectivity with FFR attributes"
format: html
---

## Prerequisites

Run `0_setup.qmd`, `1_net_with_dams_from_network.qmd`, and `2_run_connectivity_from_network.qmd` in the same R session.

## Objects needed

`out`, `out_conn`

## R source

`R/add_ffr_attr.R`

## Creates

`out_enriched`

Enrich `reach_df` with river-edge (FFR) attributes via `add_ffr_attr()`.

```{r}
#| label: source-function
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("R/add_ffr_attr.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: run-function

out_enriched <- add_ffr_attr(
  net_with_dams = out$net_with_dams,
  reach_df = out_conn$reach_df,
  edge_attr_cols = c("csi", "bas_name", "main_riv", "hyriv_id")
)
```
